subject: music
source_note: Structure follows the IB Diploma Music guide (first assessment 2022): four areas of inquiry explored through the musical processes of exploring, experimenting and presenting, in the roles of researcher, creator and performer. Component names are guide-accurate; connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).

connections.why: The areas of inquiry define the music students explore
Music technology offers tools for creative experimentation
The researcher role frames how contexts are investigated
The performer role is realised when presenting music
Investigating music leads to analysing its material
Analysis and contextual research inform each other
Analysis is the evidence shown in the exploring portfolio
Exploration sparks the ideas developed in experimentation
Creative experiments are documented in the report
Performance experiments are evidenced in the report
Experimental ideas are refined into presented created works
Performance experiments develop into polished presentations
Curating a programme shapes which works are performed
Curating decides how created works are presented
